answer: Sybil resistance is enforced as a cross-habitat quorum, not a headcount. Before an identity can move spendable balance or cast a weighted vote, its epoch work must be attested by miners whose recent graphs occupy at least three weakly overlapping habitats: a canyon of specialist low-volume tasks, a tundra of slow sealed grading, and an ocean of high-throughput settlement. A farm packed into one habitat never gathers the required mix, so extra keys do not multiply influence. Colliding or template answers are rejected together and the shared bond is burned.
